about: NIST AI 600-1 (Generative AI Profile) risk categories assessed against what the gateway and its surrounding estate demonstrably do. Deployer-side view: a gateway operator, not a model builder.

source.title: NIST AI 600-1, Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative AI Profile (July 2024) — 12 risk categories
source.caveat: Category names from NIST's profile as reported by secondary sources; suggested-action IDs (e.g. GV-1.1-001) are not mapped. Status is our own judgement.

items.title: CBRN information or capabilities
items.note: Depends on the optional Llama Guard detector; nothing specific is tested.
items.next: Include refusal probes in the purple loop.

items.title: Confabulation (confidently wrong output)
items.note: Research agent cites sources and the build contract demands tests, but answers are not checked for grounding.
items.next: Grounding check plus a small factuality probe set.

items.title: Dangerous, violent or hateful content
items.note: Optional Llama Guard detector; not exercised by a journey.
items.next: Probe set in the purple loop.

items.title: Data privacy
items.note: PII redaction (Aadhaar, PAN, cards, UPI, mobile, e-mail), residency routing and audit, proven end to end. Scope: data through the gateway.

items.title: Environmental impacts
items.note: Small local models, dormant-by-default stages and hibernation keep consumption low; nothing is measured.
items.next: Report energy-relevant measures (model size, hours awake) in the cockpit.

items.title: Human-AI configuration (over-reliance, automation bias)
items.note: Human approval for agent write actions; no indicators of answer reliability.

items.title: Information integrity
items.note: Output link allow-list and canary leak checks; no provenance or watermarking of generated content.
items.next: Mark generated output as AI-generated in exports.

items.title: Information security
items.note: Injection, exfiltration, tool-coercion rails, authentication, rate limits, audit, SOC correlation, red/purple testing, proven by journeys.

items.title: Intellectual property
items.note: No copyright or licence filter on generated text; `vet` checks licences of third-party content we vendor, not model output.
items.next: Decide the entity's position first; add an output similarity check only if required.

items.title: Obscene, degrading and/or abusive content
items.note: Optional Llama Guard detector; not exercised by a journey.
items.next: Probe set in the purple loop.

items.title: Toxicity, bias and homogenisation
items.next: Add bias probes (garak) to the purple loop; report per category.

items.title: Value chain and component integration
items.note: Third-party skills/plugins pass the `vet` gate; installers are version- and hash-pinned; SBOM in CI; supply-chain ratchet in the fitness functions.
